title: Regens Hitbox Settings
description: The mod allows you to toggle the hitbox for each entity
body:
## The mod allows you to toggle the hitbox for each entity

A lightweight utility mod that lets you control hitbox visibility for each entity in the game, including mobs, players, dropped items, and your own player hitbox.

- Default keybind: unbound (set it in your control settings)
- Toggle hitboxes per entity type
- Built-in presets with JSON sharing support
- Import, copy, refresh, and open preset files directly from the presets menu
- Active preset display for easier configuration
- Player state options for sneaking, swimming/crawling, and elytra flying

Compatible with [Combat Hitboxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/combat-hitboxes)
